name: Wanmei Lianren ~fragile love
source:
This is a story about promises and redemption.
They were childhood inseparable playmates, but when we said goodbye, they were strangers
They don't like each other, but they also attract each other,
They are incompatible opponents of fire and water, and they are a perfect match for lovers.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2773520/]Steam[/url]]
